description: As a dispatcher, I want to register a new aircraft in the system so that it becomes available for flight scheduling.

acs.text: After successful form submission, a success toast message reading 'Aircraft registered successfully' is displayed for 3 seconds.
After successful form submission, the user is immediately redirected to the aircraft list view without any confirmation message.
The form data is persisted to the database upon submit.
If the Registration Number already exists in the system, the form displays an inline error: 'Registration number already in use'.

comments: Dev (2026-05-20): AC-1 and AC-2 seem to contradict each other — one says show toast, the other says redirect immediately with no message. Needs PO clarification.
PO (2026-05-21): Will check with UX and update. Leave as-is for now.
